title: Conditional κ = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257699831143850258029546032752016286454826032563882630565613284: tighter free epsilon over PR2044
body:
This builds directly on pinned PR2044 (`322949a53488d64023fedb89a6774927707e57ba`) and tightens only the free outer epsilon point. Delta changes from `2*r0` to `(1025/1024)*r0`, with `r0=10^-30010`, epsilon `1-delta`, and beta `1-3*delta`.

The exact conditional kappa gain is approximately **1.67811457042620316926405412772e-30013**. It first changes the 30,013th decimal place. The supplier endpoint, precision, native words, owners, paid invoice and inherited hypotheses remain unchanged. This is an extremely small arithmetic refinement, not a structural supplier improvement. The exact kappa and gain are in `research/frontier2044-epsilon-refinement/CLAIM.json`.

This PR depends on #2044. The new contribution is confined to `research/frontier2044-epsilon-refinement/`; the inherited parent package is unchanged byte for byte. Its proof bounds the gain around `(1023/1024)*q*r0` to within one floor-grid step and shows the tight gamma margin remains `r0/1024 > 0`.

Validation:
- `PASS_SOURCE_BOUND_COMPLETE_FINITE_OUTER_REFINEMENT`: unchanged supplier full finite admission, fresh changed-word native replays, both exact moment engines, adjacent-grid rejection, both sets of 47 outer inequalities, and 114 admission / 12 bit / 15 controller / 8 owner / 6 geometry controls.
- Exact new point: 62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, independent nine-cost balance and exact positive gain; registered CPython 3.12 replay passes and assertion-disabled execution is rejected.
- Required gen4-bank and frontier741 checks pass. Broad `make verify` stops at a confirmed pre-existing `split-skip-check` pin mismatch for `scripts/audit_fused_block.py` (both source and frozen pin unchanged from #2044). The extra unit suite was interrupted after an inherited Git environment affected isolated fixture setup; settings restored. No whole-repository green or hosted-CI pass is claimed.
- New contribution privacy and diff checks pass. Private paths, identifiers and raw logs are excluded.

The parent has a reproducibility limitation: its committed outer artifacts use CRLF, while Linux regeneration uses LF. The unchanged outer checker passes byte-for-byte on Windows. The unchanged native supplier checker runs on Linux. This contribution binds the two completed components without changing any parent assertion or certificate; it does not claim Linux `PASS_RELEASE` for the aggregate parent wrapper. Reproduction and the full gate are documented in the package README.

All inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, recovery, analytic, prime-theorem and bit-supplier obligations remain conditional. No unconditional theorem or independent human review is claimed.

Credit PR2044 and Jeremy Kothe's package; PR1786 (Chafik Boukhalfa / Tim Trudgian), PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski), PR1758 and the retained outer lineage; PR1625, PR1672, PR1319, PR1297 and retained supplier/native contributors; PR1956 (Josie Elliston), PR1964 (Sagar Thakrar), and PR2029. Existing notices retain the detailed lineage. Prepared under dataisfire with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
